description.value: Asian Noodle House is a casual sit-down Asian restaurant on Goldstream Avenue in the commercial corridor west of Victoria, specializing in wonton soup and noodle dishes. The restaurant bills itself as serving the best wonton soup in the greater Victoria area and operates under a focused, straightforward menu. Goldstream Avenue is a well-traveled route for cyclists heading toward Goldstream Provincial Park and the Malahat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real and currently open — a vacation closure notice (Feb 2–Mar 4, 2026) is past as of today (May 28, 2026). The contact page corroborates the OSM address (313 Goldstream Ave, V9B 2W4) and supplies a phone number (250-391-0803) absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc. — are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with confirmed address and active website; a practical meal stop for cyclists on Goldstream Avenue.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone (250-391-0803) was absent from OSM and sourced from the website contact page. Seasonal vacation closure Feb 2–Mar 4, 2026 has passed; business should be open as of May 2026.
